thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] billing-metering-variance detected — token-count drift across emitters. Alert: 48m, severity P2, impacted: billing/alerts, invoices. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4891
olivia: taking this. oncall responding. quick check: is this still ongoing?
raj: seeing token_count delta between ingress and ledger ~ +14%. started ~02:10 UTC. Kafka consumer lag ~40k in metering-emit. emitter retries spiked.
li: looks like emitter-retry loop created duplicates. logs:
```
emitter: write succeeded, id=abc123
emitter: retrying flush, id=abc123, attempt=3, dup_lock=false
```
nina: CS - Support: 3 customers reported overage emails, one paused trial. Holding invoices for affected orgs?
olivia: yes, pause invoice generation for flagged orgs. raj, can we identify affected org ids? priority.
raj: running query now. sample: org_998, org_77, org_204. pushing a live filter to billing pipeline to exclude retries count.
jamie: FYI, aggregation job "count-aggregator-v2" shows late windows from 02:00-02:30. Might be consumer rebalancing.
li: propose immediate mitigation: (1) stop emitter retries by toggling feature flag emitter.retry.enable -> false (2) run dedupe job on transient ledger (3) apply shadow filter for invoices
olivia: do the flag toggle. who can patch?
raj: I can toggle the flag in prod console. toggling now.
incident-bot: action taken: feature flag emitter.retry.enable=false by raj at 03:08 UTC
raj: toggled. monitoring for duplicate arrivals.
nina: support: customers notified with "investigating" note. no billing adjustments yet.
olivia: start a backfill plan. Li, how long estimate for dedupe run?
li: dedupe dry run estimate ~25m, full run 1.5h depending on backlog. will kick off dry run first.
jamie: also reroute metrics to fallback aggregator to avoid double-counting during backfill.
olivia: assign followups: raj -> list affected orgs + temp invoice hold, li -> dedupe dry run + report, nina -> customer comms. set status to monitoring.
product-ops: flagging for postmortem and potential credits policy.
olivia: updates: dedupe dry run complete, found ~7% dupes in that window. scheduling full run now. backfill job id: backfill-20240315-01
raj: found 12 orgs with >50% delta, raising for manual review.
nina: support to prepare customer impact doc and template credits note.
olivia: last update: full dedupe + backfill finished 04:35 UTC. final delta reduced to <0.2%. invoices paused released only for non-impacted accounts. closing incident, will open follow-up doc.
incident-bot: incident status: resolved -> postmortem required. duration: ~2h25m. link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4891/postmortem
